title: Noah's Ark and the Flood Begins: Genesis 5-7 Bible Story (KJV)
description:
Noah's Ark, from Enoch who walked with God to the day the flood begins, read from the King James Version: Genesis 5:21-24, Genesis 6 and Genesis 7. Four stories in one sitting, with the Keeper's honest questions in between.
